# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.
[ Oncology ][167]
[ Immunology ][168]
[ Neuroscience ][169]
[ Cardiopulmonary ][170]
[ Learn more ][171]
[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.
[ Cardiovascular ][173]
[ Orthopaedics ][174]
[ Surgery ][175]
[ Vision ][176]

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.
[ Oncology ][167]
[ Immunology ][168]
[ Neuroscience ][169]
[ Cardiopulmonary ][170]
[ Learn more ][171]
[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.
[ Cardiovascular ][173]
[ Orthopaedics ][174]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

Home

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

4. Medtronic AI Compass

Healthcare Professionals

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]
Previous Next
1. Slide 1

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

# Celebrating 170 years

A legacy of healthcare innovation. A future without limits.

Discover our story

# Life Unlimited

Smith+Nephew is a portfolio medical technology company focused on the repair, regeneration and
replacement of soft and hard tissue. We exist to restore people's bodies and their self-belief by
using technology to take the limits off living.

[Sports Medicine]

# Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

Explore sports medicine
[Ultimate victory]

# Ultimate victory

Hear the story of how our technology, in the hands of a leading surgeon, helped Tom Aspinall recover
from a career-threatening injury to become the UFC world heavyweight champion.

Explore Tom Aspinall's story
Celebrating 170 years
Life Unlimited

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

[ Explore orthopaedic reconstruction ][91]

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

[ Explore orthopaedic reconstruction ][91]

coronary CTA obtained on conventional 320-row MDCT scanners and could support expanded use of CTA
for stent evaluation.

[article cover]

[¹⁸F]FDG PET.

copayment amounts.

##### Spreading Hope | Creating Awareness | Providing Support


Content on this site is not to be used as a substitute for direct medical advice from your doctor or
other qualified clinician.

## Aortic Disease: The Patient Guide
## [Free Download][25] | YouTube Playlist

 

This guide is here to help you and your loved ones understand what comes next after a diagnosis of
aortic disease. Every journey is unique—shaped by the type of condition, timing of diagnosis, and
overall health. That’s why personalized care and informed decisions are so important.


We know this can feel overwhelming, but you don’t have to absorb everything at once. Think of this
guide as a map—explore the parts that matter most to you right now.


For families and caregivers, your support is invaluable. Whether helping manage appointments or
offering a listening ear, your patience and understanding make a powerful difference.


You are not alone on this journey—we’re here to walk it with you.

prizes!

## 
## Aortic Dissection: The Patient Guide
## [Free Download][30] | [YouTube Playlist][31]

 

With a heartfelt thanks to the team at [Aortic Dissection UK & Ireland][32]. Aortic Hope along with
[Think Aorta US][33] are proud to present [Aortic Dissection: The Patient Guide][34]. This guide is
[free for download][35]. There is a [bulk order form][36] as well for the Medical Community to
provide for their patients.


 

Con un sincero agradecimiento al equipo de [Aortic Dissection UK & Ireland][37]. Aortic Hope y
[Think Aorta US][38] se enorgullecen de presentar [Disección aórtica: La Guía del Paciente][39].
Esta guía se puede [descargar gratuitamente][40]. También hay un [formulario de pedido a granel][41]
para que la comunidad médica lo distribuya a sus pacientes.

Disección aórtica: Encuesta de la Guía del Paciente | ¡Los comentarios no anónimos participarán en
los premios mensuales!


## Our Impact

 

## 9000+


##### FOLLOWERS AND SUPPORTERS


In addition to a strong online presence, our community outreach is enabling us to expand our mission
globally.

[Aortic HOPE]

 

Since Aortic Hope was founded in 2016, we have provided support to individuals within the community
and we are still growing! Initially, our Hope Mail Care Packages were sent to 30 people and now that
program has grown by almost 400%! Our live educational videos are spanning the globe! We have been
heard over Sirius XM, spoken at Rock from the Heart Symposiums, connected with countries who have
adopted the Think Aorta campaign, and seen on The Donna Drake Show!


 

## 45+

 

##### GLOBAL PRESENCE AND GROWING


Other than the United States, Aortic Hope has reached individuals in Canada, Australia, Sweden, UK,
India, Angola, Kenya, New Zealand and more!


[Aortic HOPE]

 

## 5200+


##### HOSPITAL REACH


 

In collaboration with the non-profit Think Aorta US, Aortic Hope has a presence in over 5200
hospitals in the US!

### Our 2025-2026 Sponsors

[[Aortic HOPE]][55]

[At Cook Medical, we innovate and manufacture quality medical devices to improve lives. We focus on
bringing compelling products to market and keeping existing ones relevant. With headquarters in
Bloomington, Indiana, and global manufacturing facilities, we aim to increase our impact
worldwide. ][56]


[[Aortic HOPE]][57]

Doherty Cella Keane LLP is a national law firm dedicated to representing individuals seeking Social
Security disability benefits. With over 40 years in Social Security disability expertise, we
guarantee that an experienced attorney will work your case from the very first call to ensure you
receive the expert representation needed to navigate the Social Security Disability process.

[[Aortic HOPE]][58]

Heart Valve Voice US, a patient advocacy nonprofit organization, provides patients with a united
voice to improve health for people living with heart valve disease by advocating for early
detection, meaningful support, and timely access to appropriate treatment for all affected. Heart
Valve Voice works with people living with heart valve disease, clinicians and other experts, and
other patient service and advocacy organizations to identify barriers to improving health for people
living with valve disease and advocates for change to enhance health.

[[Aortic HOPE]][59]

Edwards Lifesciences is the global leader of patient-focused medical innovations for structural
heart disease and critical care monitoring.


At Edwards Lifesciences, we listen when patients talk. Why? Because patients provide us with
information about their experience, which can help us improve our products. Their stories inspire us
to continue to fight on their behalf. And they can provide comfort and support to each other when we
help them connect." If you would like to learn more about Edwards Lifesciences, their resources for
patients, and their Patient Experience, click [here][60].
 

[[Aortic HOPE]][61]

[This event is a passion project, founded and directed, by Carmen David after surviving an aortic
dissection in May 2015, 22hrs after the birth of her second daughter.  Run for Aortic Health raises
funds specifically earmarked for research to be sent to The John Ritter Foundation for their
research program (JRRP), and other related research studies and initiatives for Aortic Aneurysm and
Aortic Dissection; This crucial work paves the way for aortic disease to be better understood and
managed.  ][62]

## Aortic Disease: The Patient Guide
## [Free Download][25] | YouTube Playlist

 

This guide is here to help you and your loved ones understand what comes next after a diagnosis of
aortic disease. Every journey is unique—shaped by the type of condition, timing of diagnosis, and
overall health. That’s why personalized care and informed decisions are so important.


We know this can feel overwhelming, but you don’t have to absorb everything at once. Think of this
guide as a map—explore the parts that matter most to you right now.


For families and caregivers, your support is invaluable. Whether helping manage appointments or
offering a listening ear, your patience and understanding make a powerful difference.


You are not alone on this journey—we’re here to walk it with you.

## Choose Chinese General Hospital and Medical Center.

We have more than 130 years of trusted health and compassionate care.

## Exceptional, World Class Doctors

Our medical experts are among the country’s best in primary care as well as in a wide-range of
medical specialties, including neurosurgery, coronary artery bypass grafting, angioplasty,
minimally-invasive robotic surgery, oncology, and many more.
[ Our Doctors ][71]

## Exceptional, State-of-the-Art Facilities and Equipment

We provide the highest quality care and best solutions for our patients by constantly upgrading our
facilities and equipment with the latest medical innovations such as the country’s first Dual
Console da Vinci Xi Robotic Surgical System, the most complete Cancer Institute and Heart Institute,
among others.
[ Learn More ][72]

## Compassionate Care

We know that patients in need of medical care are at their most vulnerable selves, that is why our
fundamental tenet is compassionate care.  All our medical doctors, nursing, and allied health
professionals are committed to providing effective and person-centered care, treating every patient
with empathy and respect.
[ Learn More ][73]

We examine the evidence behind questions that affect people’s lives, empowering everyone to make

### We change lives
### and systems

### Our evidence
### is trusted

### globally

public. [Get involved][25].

* [ ][27]
  
  [Exercise helps hip arthritis pain, but perhaps less than we thought][28]
  
  23 July 2026
  
  A new Cochrane review finds that exercise may improve pain and function, but the benefits may fall
  short of what patients would notice in daily life.
* [ ][29]
  
  [Why evidence synthesis matters in the age of AI][30]
  
  22 July 2026
  
  In an era defined by an abundance of information, and new ways to find it, Cochrane’s Chief
  Executive Officer, Karla Soares-Weiser argues that systematic reviews remain an essential tool to
  help individuals, healthcare professionals and policymakers make decisions. However, the challenge
  is no longer simply producing reliable evidence but maintaining the trust that makes Cochrane’s
  evidence useful.

  [Building a volunteer network through Cochrane Engage][32]
  
  16 July 2026
  
  Knowledge translation (KT) is a key part of ensuring that high-quality evidence reaches the people
  who can use it. In Italy, however, research methods and evidence-based medicine (EBM) are not
  consistently integrated into higher education or medical education programmes.

  Centre’.

## Know what's happening in real time

Distill continuously monitors news coverage, press releases, company blogs, and LinkedIn posts — so
you don't have to check dozens of sources manually.

## Only see the updates worth your attention

Distill filters out duplicate coverage, low-signal updates, and irrelevant noise, helping you
quickly spot the developments that actually matter.

[OpenAI icon]

OpenAI releases new AI model

Reasoning and multimodality improved

Stripe closes Bridge acquisition

Expands stablecoin infrastructure

## Get alerts where your team already works

Receive instant alerts in Slack or Microsoft Teams, read weekly email briefings, or browse
everything in Distill's live feed.

Start tracking your market today

Set up your watchlist in minutes. Start monitoring the companies that matter to you.

[Start for free ][6]

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

## Know what's happening in real time

Distill continuously monitors news coverage, press releases, company blogs, and LinkedIn posts — so
you don't have to check dozens of sources manually.

## Only see the updates worth your attention

Distill filters out duplicate coverage, low-signal updates, and irrelevant noise, helping you
quickly spot the developments that actually matter.

## Get alerts where your team already works

Receive instant alerts in Slack or Microsoft Teams, read weekly email briefings, or browse

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

## Inspiring Stories

Visiting the gynecology department at this clinic has been a positive experience from the start. The
gynecologists are incredibly knowledgeable and compassionate. They prioritize my comfort and health
in every interaction, making important aspects of womanhood so much easier to navigate.
Maria L.Gynecology Testimonial
Digestive issues were disrupting my life until I discovered the expertise of this clinic's
gastroenterology specialists. They conducted thorough assessments and provided tailored solutions
that brought me relief. Thanks to their care, I can now enjoy meals without the constant discomfort.
Alex B.Gastroenterology Testimonial

this clinic were my guiding light. They truly listened to my struggles and crafted a comprehensive
treatment plan that suited my needs. With their support, I've achieved hormonal balance and regained
my energy and vitality.
David M. David M. Endocrinology Testimonial

##### [Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Repair][45]

Abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) repair is a surgical procedure performed to treat an aneurysm—a
bulging and weakened area in the abdominal aorta, the main artery that carries blood from the heart
to the lower body. If left untreated, an AAA can enlarge over time and may lead to a rupture, which
is a life-threatening medical emergency.

[View More ][46]

##### [Minimally invasive dialysis access salvage][47]

Minimally invasive dialysis access salvage refers to procedures and interventions aimed at
preserving and restoring the functionality of an existing dialysis access (e.g., fistula or graft)
that may be experiencing complications or dysfunction. These minimally invasive techniques are
designed to avoid the need for major surgeries, reduce patient discomfort.

[View More ][48]

##### [Carotid Disease Management and Surgery for Stroke][49]

Carotid disease management and surgery play a crucial role in preventing strokes caused by carotid
artery stenosis, a condition where the carotid arteries, the major arteries in the neck supplying
blood to the brain, become narrowed or blocked due to atherosclerosis. Carotid artery disease is a
significant risk factor for ischemic strokes.

[View More ][50]

##### [Catheter Based Angioplasty and Stenting][51]

Catheter-based angioplasty and stenting are minimally invasive procedures used to treat narrow or
blocked blood vessels, typically arteries. These procedures are commonly performed in various parts
of the body, such as the heart (coronary arteries), legs (peripheral arteries), neck (carotid
arteries), and kidneys (renal arteries).

[View More ][52]

##### [Vascular Trauma and malformations][53]

Vascular trauma and malformations are two distinct vascular conditions that affect the blood vessels
in the body. While they have different causes and characteristics, both conditions can lead to
significant health issues.Traumatic vascular injuries can range from mild contusions or bruises to
severe lacerations or disruptions of blood vessels.

[View More ][54]

##### [Endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR)][55]

Endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR) is a minimally invasive procedure used to treat abdominal aortic
aneurysms (AAA). An AAA is a bulging and weakened area in the abdominal aorta, the main artery that
carries blood from the heart to the lower body. If left untreated, an AAA can enlarge over time and
may lead to a rupture.

[View More ][56]

##### [Deep Venous Thrombosis][57]

Deep Venous Thrombosis (DVT) is a medical condition characterized by the formation of a blood clot
(thrombus) within a deep vein, usually in the legs. DVT occurs when blood flow is reduced or
obstructed, leading to the accumulation of blood and clotting factors within the vein. If not
detected and treated promptly, DVT can have serious consequences.

[View More ][58]

##### [Peripheral Arterial Aneurysms][59]

Peripheral arterial aneurysms are abnormal dilations or bulges that occur in the arteries outside of
the heart and brain. These aneurysms can develop in various peripheral arteries, including those in
the arms, legs, abdomen, and other parts of the body. Like aneurysms in other areas, peripheral
arterial aneurysms can be a cause for concern because they can grow larger over time .

[View More ][60]

##### [Peripheral Arterial Disease][33]

Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD), also known as peripheral vascular disease (PVD), is a common
circulatory problem in which narrowed arteries reduce blood flow to the limbs, typically the legs.
PAD is primarily caused by atherosclerosis, a condition where fatty deposits (plaque) build up
inside the arteries.

[View More ][34]

##### [Diabetic Foot and Limb Salvage][35]

Diabetic foot complications and limb salvage are critical aspects of diabetes management,
particularly for individuals who have developed complications due to Peripheral Arterial Disease
(PAD) and Diabetic Foot Ulcers (DFUs). Diabetes can lead to nerve damage (neuropathy) and poor blood
circulation (PAD).

[View More ][36]

##### [Varicose Veins and Ulcer Management][37]

Varicose veins are enlarged, swollen, and twisted veins that typically occur in the legs and feet.
They develop when the valves within the veins that help regulate blood flow become weakened or
damaged, causing blood to pool and the veins to stretch. Over time, this can lead to various
complications, including venous ulcers.

[View More ][38]

##### [Dialysis Access – Fistula and Graft][39]

Dialysis access is a critical aspect of the treatment for individuals with end-stage renal disease
(ESRD) who require hemodialysis. Hemodialysis is a medical procedure that filters waste products and
excess fluids from the blood. To facilitate hemodialysis, a reliable access point to the bloodstream
is necessary.

[View More ][40]

##### [Vascular screening services][41]

Vascular screening services are medical examinations or tests that are specifically designed to
assess the health of the blood vessels and identify any potential abnormalities or risk factors.
This is particularly important for individuals with risk factors for vascular diseases, such as
older age, smoking, high blood pressure, diabetes, and a family history of vascular problems.

[View More ][42]

##### [Noninvasive Angiography of Peripheral Arteries][43]

Noninvasive angiography of peripheral arteries, used to visualize and assess the blood vessels in
the arms and legs without the need for invasive procedures. These techniques provide valuable
information about the health and integrity of the peripheral arterial system and help in the
diagnosis and management of various vascular conditions.

[View More ][44]

##### [Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Repair][45]

Abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) repair is a surgical procedure performed to treat an aneurysm—a
bulging and weakened area in the abdominal aorta, the main artery that carries blood from the heart
to the lower body. If left untreated, an AAA can enlarge over time and may lead to a rupture, which
is a life-threatening medical emergency.

[View More ][46]

##### [Minimally invasive dialysis access salvage][47]

Minimally invasive dialysis access salvage refers to procedures and interventions aimed at
preserving and restoring the functionality of an existing dialysis access (e.g., fistula or graft)
that may be experiencing complications or dysfunction. These minimally invasive techniques are
designed to avoid the need for major surgeries, reduce patient discomfort.

[View More ][48]

##### [Carotid Disease Management and Surgery for Stroke][49]

Carotid disease management and surgery play a crucial role in preventing strokes caused by carotid
artery stenosis, a condition where the carotid arteries, the major arteries in the neck supplying
blood to the brain, become narrowed or blocked due to atherosclerosis. Carotid artery disease is a
significant risk factor for ischemic strokes.

[View More ][50]

##### [Catheter Based Angioplasty and Stenting][51]

Catheter-based angioplasty and stenting are minimally invasive procedures used to treat narrow or
blocked blood vessels, typically arteries. These procedures are commonly performed in various parts
of the body, such as the heart (coronary arteries), legs (peripheral arteries), neck (carotid
arteries), and kidneys (renal arteries).

[View More ][52]

##### [Vascular Trauma and malformations][53]

Vascular trauma and malformations are two distinct vascular conditions that affect the blood vessels
in the body. While they have different causes and characteristics, both conditions can lead to
significant health issues.Traumatic vascular injuries can range from mild contusions or bruises to
severe lacerations or disruptions of blood vessels.

[View More ][54]

##### [Endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR)][55]

Endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR) is a minimally invasive procedure used to treat abdominal aortic
aneurysms (AAA). An AAA is a bulging and weakened area in the abdominal aorta, the main artery that
carries blood from the heart to the lower body. If left untreated, an AAA can enlarge over time and
may lead to a rupture.

[View More ][56]

##### [Deep Venous Thrombosis][57]

Deep Venous Thrombosis (DVT) is a medical condition characterized by the formation of a blood clot
(thrombus) within a deep vein, usually in the legs. DVT occurs when blood flow is reduced or
obstructed, leading to the accumulation of blood and clotting factors within the vein. If not
detected and treated promptly, DVT can have serious consequences.

[View More ][58]

##### [Peripheral Arterial Aneurysms][59]

Peripheral arterial aneurysms are abnormal dilations or bulges that occur in the arteries outside of
the heart and brain. These aneurysms can develop in various peripheral arteries, including those in
the arms, legs, abdomen, and other parts of the body. Like aneurysms in other areas, peripheral
arterial aneurysms can be a cause for concern because they can grow larger over time .

[View More ][60]

#### At Hoag, we combine clinical excellence with compassionate, personalized care—earning top
#### rankings for quality, safety and outcomes.

Patients choose Hoag because we deliver more than expertise. We offer access to advanced treatments,
cutting-edge technology, and a robust portfolio of clinical trials, all within a system built around

care, improving lives, and being the health partner you trust.

County’s need for access to comprehensive, world-class care.

Easily accessible to patients throughout Orange County and beyond, the campus will bring together
comprehensive services including cancer care, digestive health, women’s health, imaging, and
outpatient procedures all within one integrated location.

# **Welcome to Chennai Vascular Surgeon:**

Welcome to the website for the Division of Vascular Surgery and the Center for Treatment of Vascular
Disease at Apollo Hospital,Chennai. The Center is dedicated to the comprehensive understanding and
treatment of vascular diseases, as it affects arteries, veins and lymphatics. The Center has three
primary goals, the most important of which is prevention and treatment of vascular disease. We are
staffed by a team composed of board certified vascular surgeons and endovascular specialists, a
vascular internist, and assisted by a group of Vascular Nurse Specialists, Nurse Practitioners,
Physicians Assistants and nutritionists. Dr. V. Balaji, MS.,FRCS[Eng]., FRCS[Edin]., FRCS[Gen].,
FICS. He was born in the year 1963 and had is undergraduate medical education at Madras Medical
College Chennai. He graduated in the year 1986 and joined post graduate surgical training
immediately at Madras Medical College and Government General Hospital Chennai. He passed out in 1989
and left for United Kingdom for further higher surgical training. He obtained FRCS from Royal
college of Surgeons of England in 1989 and FRCS from Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh in1990.
In 1997 he was first overseas candidate to obtain FRCS from Inter Collegiate Board of Royal
Colleges. In the same year in recognition of his excellent academic performance he was elected
Fellow of International College of Surgeons by the European Section of the college.

We provide a unique personal approach, day-to-day support, and all the tools you need to make your work accessible worldwide. ### Peer-review Our robust peer review ensures your work is suitable for publication and valuable to the scientific community. ### Online First On acceptance of your work, our early online publication provides access to the scientific community without delay. ### Open Access Your work will be permanently available online, free to download, share and read. ## 11,600+ Research Institutions Support Open Access at IntechOpen [View All Institutions][62] [[City University Of Hong Kong]][63] [[Iowa State University]][64] [[Fudan University]][65] [[Kings College]][66] [[Peking University]][67] [[Seoul]][68] [[Tsinghua University]][69] [[UMass Amherst]][70] [[Universidadde Buenos Aires]][71] [[Universidad Rey Juan Carlosde]][72] [[Universitatde Barcelona]][73] [[Universitéde Strasbourg]][74] [[University of Kansas]][75] [[CSIC]][76] [[University of Surrey]][77] 06 May 2026 ##### Reaching New Heights: IntechOpen Publishes its 8,000th Open Access Book IntechOpen is proud to announce a significant milestone for 2026: the publication of our 8,000th open access book. This milestone comes shortly after the 20th anniversary of the publication of our first OA book. [Read more][78] 18 December 2025 ##### 20 Years of Open Access Books: A Milestone for IntechOpen Over the past two decades, IntechOpen has grown into a global leader in open access book publishing, with an ever-expanding catalogue covering STM, as well as the social sciences and humanities. This milestone reflects not only the company’s achievements but also the growing recognition of open access books as a vital model for academic publishing, contributing to the transformation of how knowledge is shared worldwide. [Read more][79] 16 October 2025 ##### IntechOpen Among First Publishers to Go Live with OA Switchboard Books Solution We are proud to announce that IntechOpen is among the first three publishers, alongside Cambridge University Press and University of Michigan Press, to go live with the OA Switchboard Books Solution. [Read more][80] 23 April 2025 ##### IntechOpen Marked 7,500th OA Book Release with 'Climate Policies,' Co-edited by Members of ##### Nobel Peace Prize-Winning IPCC Team Co-edited by Gary Yohe and Joel Smith, senior members of the 2007 Nobel Peace Prize-winning Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), this timely volume offers a comprehensive evaluation of contemporary climate policy strategies. [Read more][81] 25 March 2025 ##### ResearchGate and IntechOpen Announce New Journal Home Partnership As part of our ongoing commitment to expanding the reach and visibility of open access research, we are excited to announce a new partnership with ResearchGate, the leading professional network for researchers. This collaboration will increase the reach and brand visibility of our journals through ResearchGate’s Journal Home platform. [Read more][82] 08 July 2024 ##### IntechOpen Presents Interviews for Young Scientists with Science's Leading Minds We are pleased to present a series of inspirational interviews for young researchers with some of today's leading scientists, ranging from a Nobel laureate to pioneers and innovators in various fields, including pharmacogenomics, pharmaceutical leadership, and academia. [Read more][83] 22 May 2024 ##### IntechOpen Reaches New Milestone: 7,000 Books Open for All IntechOpen has achieved a significant milestone in its mission to democratise scientific knowledge by announcing the publication of its 7,000th open access book, 'Towards the Eradication of* Helicobacter pylori* Infection - Rapid Diagnosis and Precision Treatment.' Guided by the expertise of Dr Liang Wang, Dr Alfred Chin Yen Tay, and 2005 Nobel Prize Laureate Prof. Barry J. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. [Read more][86] 28 March 2023 ##### IntechOpen Book Wins the 2022 International Academy of Astronautics Life Science Book Award We are thrilled that the International Academy of Astronautics has chosen IntechOpen's book "Preparation of Space Experiments", edited by Dr. Vladimir Pletser, to receive the IAA Life Science Book Award. The award is given annually to recognize excellence in publication by an Academy member or corresponding member in the field of life sciences. Get started

## trusted by thousands of companies globally

why lemon squeezy?

## integration and more. We make running your software business easy peasy.

04

**Lemon Squeezy protects you from malicious attacks**.

06

subscriptions, card retries, and customer emails.

anywhere in minutes. **Utilize no-code checkout links** without worrying about design, mobile
optimization, or payment integrations. It really is easy-peasy.

e/1

][37][

Build an ecommerce website in minutes **without coding or design skills**. Customizable, SSL secured
and mobile-optimized as standard.

email list, you can do it all with Lemon Squeezy.

easy-to-use marketing tools**. Whether you need to offer discount codes or you want to build your

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

## Mount Bonnell Gallery

Check out our gallery page with beautiful photos of Mount Bonn that other visitors have shared. Why
not share your own favorite pic featuring Mount Bonnell for the chance to win a cool t-shirt?

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

# Our Vision:To Transform Lives by Revolutionizing Treatment of Aneurysmal Disease

## Nectero Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech company pioneering novel therapies with a
## potential to treat aneurysmal disease and improve patients’ lives.

The company is led by a highly accomplished, multidisciplinary management team with input from an
experienced board of directors and renowned physician leaders in vascular surgery and interventions.
[Learn More][19]

Abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA) represent a significant public health concern:
* Current surgical or endovascular treatments are reserved for AAA larger than 5.5cm (5.0cm in
  women) in diameter, in symptomatic patients, or in rapidly expanding aneurysms
* Smaller AAAs are traditionally monitored with serial ultrasound or computed tomography (CT)
  surveillance

[Learn More][20]

## Nectero Therapeutics is developing an investigational treatment with the potential to stabilize
## growth and minimize risk of rupture of small to mid-sized AAA

Nectero Endovascular Aneurysm Stabilization Treatment (Nectero EAST^{®}) System uses an endovascular
approach to deliver a proprietary mixture to the site of the aneurysm.

Treatment with the Nectero EAST^{®} System may prevent or significantly delay the need for major
intervention. By minimizing further degradation of the aneurysm and strengthening the aortic tissue
around the aneurysm, many patients can live out their normal life span and never need to face the
challenges of endovascular repair (EVAR) or open surgery to address their aneurysm. [Learn More][21]

# Welcome to Northeast Georgia Physicians Group

**Northeast Georgia Physicians Group (NGPG)** brings together over 700 talented physicians,
physician assistants, nurse practitioners, midwives and other clinical staff at more than 50
locations across North Georgia. As the state’s sixth-largest physician group, we always have a
practice nearby to offer you expert care in more than 40 specialties.

NGPG is affiliated with [Northeast Georgia Health System (NGHS)][60], a non-profit which serves more
than 1 million people in 19 counties across the region. As part of NGHS, patients of NGPG have a
direct connection to Northeast Georgia Medical Center’s seven hospitals in Gainesville, Braselton,
Winder, Dahlonega and Demorest.

# Welcome to Northeast Georgia Physicians Group

**Northeast Georgia Physicians Group (NGPG)** brings together over 700 talented physicians,
physician assistants, nurse practitioners, midwives and other clinical staff at more than 50
locations across North Georgia. As the state’s sixth-largest physician group, we always have a
practice nearby to offer you expert care in more than 40 specialties.

NGPG is affiliated with [Northeast Georgia Health System (NGHS)][60], a non-profit which serves more
than 1 million people in 19 counties across the region. As part of NGHS, patients of NGPG have a
direct connection to Northeast Georgia Medical Center’s seven hospitals in Gainesville, Braselton,
Winder, Dahlonega and Demorest.

You. **When was the last time you saw an ad for apples or a billboard for broccoli?** The system is set up to promote pills, not produce. **NutritionFacts.org is a science-based nonprofit charity** committed to bringing the medical literature to you, breaking down the latest in evidence-based nutrition research, and presenting the results in ways that are easy to understand. We regularly share videos, blogs, webinars, live Q&As, guides, infographics, and more—without commercial bias, sponsors, or ads, so every one of us can make the best dietary and lifestyle choices. [About Us][56] [Videos][57] [Resources][58] ## Our Values ### Evidence-Based Every day, about 5,000 scientific papers are published in peer-reviewed medical journals, and groundbreaking nutrition research too often gets lost and buried. We comb through the literature and share practical tips to improve your life. ### Accessible Science is universal, so we are committed to presenting the latest in nutrition and health research in ways that are easy to understand no matter your background or training, in many different languages, and at no cost to you. ### Accountable Corrupting commercial and ideological interests have led to a stew of nutritional misinformation. Don't take anyone's word on something as life-and-death important as what to eat and feed your family. Our videos cite the science and also show the actual studies and link to all the original sources. ### Non-Commercial As a nonprofit organization, we offer a strictly non-commercial public service. We do not accept advertisements, corporate sponsorships, brand partnerships, or paid subscriptions, and all funds received from speaking engagements and book sales are donated directly to charity. ## Frequently asked questions about OpenTable

OpenTable helps you discover the best restaurants for every occasion. Through the website and app,
you can explore over 65,000 restaurants worldwide and instantly see what’s available nearby. Quickly
narrow down your choices by filtering for new restaurants, hidden culinary gems, local favorites,
and more. Whether you’re looking to book top restaurants near you or MICHELIN-Starred restaurants
around the world, OpenTable has you covered.

#### Why should I use OpenTable to find restaurants?

With over 65,000+ restaurants worldwide, the OpenTable website and app offer a one-stop-shop to
discover and book restaurants. Search by date, time, and location to see what’s available, and then
narrow down your options using filters like outdoor seating, price range or dietary restrictions.

#### Can I read or leave a restaurant review on OpenTable?

Yes! Restaurant profiles feature reviews from verified diners who have actually visited the
restaurant so that you know you’re getting an accurate account. And you can join in—after you dine,
you’ll be prompted to leave a review of your experience.

Your first scan analysis is free — no credit card, no subscription.

## The Medical AI Behind Your Report

ReadYourLab is powered by purpose-built medical AI models — not general-purpose chatbots. Every scan
report and document analysis is generated by models specifically trained on medical imaging and
clinical data.

### Google MedGemma 1.5

CT & MRI Scan Analysis

Your [CT scan][43] & [MRI scan][44] are evaluated by **MedGemma 1.5 from Google Research**. This is
a specialized 4-billion-parameter medical AI built on Gemma 3, with a medically-tuned vision encoder
(MedSigLIP) trained on de-identified medical imaging data. It reviews every slice of your scan as a
complete 3D volume — just like a radiologist would.
* Full 3D volumetric analysis of CT and MRI DICOM series
* Understands MRI sequences: T1, T2, FLAIR, DWI, contrast-enhanced
* Trained on medical imaging datasets including MIMIC-CXR and ChestImaGenome
* 128K token context window for processing large scan series

[ MedGemma capabilities & limitations ][45]

### OpenAI GPT

Medical Q&A & Document Analysis

Your medical questions, radiology reports, and clinical notes are evaluated by **OpenAI's GPT**. GPT
handles question answering, summarization, and reasoning to synthesize findings from multiple
sources and deliver context-aware explanations in plain language.
* State-of-the-art results on the MedQA benchmark
* Analyzes lab reports, bloodwork, clinical notes, and X-rays
* Connects lab results, scan data, and clinical notes for cross-referenced insights
* Ask unlimited follow-up questions in plain language

[ Read more about GPT ][46]

### How We Use AI Responsibly

Transparency is central to how we operate. Here's what you should know about our AI analysis.

#### Open Benchmarks, No Black Box

MedGemma 1.5 is published and peer-reviewed with full benchmark data on [arXiv][47] and Google's
[model card][48]. We disclose exactly what the AI can and cannot do. For more details, see the
[MedGemma Technical Report][49] (Sellergren et al., 2025).

#### Informational, Not Diagnostic

ReadYourLab provides an AI-generated plain-language walk-through of your images to help you
understand your scan before or after your doctor's appointment. It is **not a substitute for a
licensed radiologist or physician**. Always consult your healthcare provider for medical decisions.
[AI vs. Radiologist — honest comparison][50].

Your scans are encrypted in transit and at rest. We never share your medical data with third

[Dr. Zoltán Nyárády, Co-Founder and Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon at ReadYourLab]

Dr. Zoltán Nyárády

Co-Founder · Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon

MD, DMD, PhD

My specialty is oral surgery, dental implantation, and minimally invasive oral surgical procedures.

The greatest reward for me is when patients who once feared the dentist, oral surgeon, or implant

Peter Nemeth

Co-Founder

I spent most of my career building enterprise software products at ServiceNow, HP, and IBM. After a
cancer diagnosis, I remember staring at a grey CT scan and feeling completely lost — with no idea
what I was looking at. Using AI to finally understand what was happening in my own body was
transformational.

I built ReadYourLab to give everyone access to the tool I wish I'd had during this time.

## Our Mission

deserves the ability to view and understand their own scans.

We believe the best way to make medical imaging more useful is to put it directly in the hands of
patients. We want patients to be able to view, use, and understand their data in ways the
traditional healthcare system simply doesn't allow. Patients should be able to decide how to engage
with their own health and take control of their care in collaboration with their doctors.

AI-powered tools for explaining and visualizing the human body are a powerful way to give patients
the freedom of information and medical education they deserve.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

## Robot Applications

Use robot arms for any manufacturing application. You can find plenty of examples in our
documentation.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

## Robot Applications

Use robot arms for any manufacturing application. You can find plenty of examples in our
documentation.

## About Us

South Valley Vascular opened in 2005 and now has 4 offices in Central Valley.

At South Valley Vascular, we focus on more than just treatment — we prioritize your overall
experience. From the moment you walk through our doors, our goal is to offer efficient, effective
care in a calm, welcoming setting. Our team of board-certified, fellowship-trained surgeons brings
extensive expertise in vascular surgery and minimally invasive procedures, using the latest
techniques and technology to deliver excellent outcomes. Recognized throughout the Central Valley,
our surgeons are trusted by both patients and referring physicians alike. We’ve built a team that
shares our commitment to compassionate, detail-oriented care — because we believe the best results
start with the best experience. Have a question? Reach out anytime — our knowledgeable, friendly
staff is always here to help.

## What We Do

Vascular surgeons treat a wide range of diseases and conditions aﬀecting the arteries and veins,
specifically focusing on the circulatory system outside of the heart and brain.
[
Our Treatments

They are ugly, blue or purple veins that look like twisted or bulging cords. Leg veins are most
affected by varicosity. They are a cosmetic issue and may become a medical issue.

## Peripheral Artery Disease

PAD is a disease of the arteries of the legs. It is common, affecting 20% of people over the age of
65. When blood vessels in the legs become blocked with fatty deposits circulation is obstructed.

## Carotid Artery Disease

Carotid artery disease is atherosclerosis (hardening of the arteries) causing the carotid arteries
to narrow or become blocked, which may cause a stroke. This is a serious, life-threatening
condition.

Dialysis Access Care is the vascular creation and care of your vascular access for dialysis. It
makes life-saving dialysis possible. A vascular surgeon surgically creates an arteriovenous fistula
to allow the body to remove and return blood during dialysis.

## About Us

South Valley Vascular opened in 2005 and now has 4 offices in Central Valley.

At South Valley Vascular, we focus on more than just treatment — we prioritize your overall
experience. From the moment you walk through our doors, our goal is to offer efficient, effective
care in a calm, welcoming setting. Our team of board-certified, fellowship-trained surgeons brings
extensive expertise in vascular surgery and minimally invasive procedures, using the latest
techniques and technology to deliver excellent outcomes. Recognized throughout the Central Valley,
our surgeons are trusted by both patients and referring physicians alike. We’ve built a team that
shares our commitment to compassionate, detail-oriented care — because we believe the best results
start with the best experience. Have a question? Reach out anytime — our knowledgeable, friendly
staff is always here to help.

specifically focusing on the circulatory system outside of the heart and brain.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial

subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents

standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

# Redefining the Standard of Care for Aortic Aneurysm Treatment

Taurus Vascular is a Houston-based medical device company focused on improving long-term outcomes
for patients with aortic aneurysms.

[ Get in Touch ][11]

## The Standard of Care

Each year, over one million people are diagnosed with an abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA), which is a
bulging, dilation or ballooning in the wall of a blood vessel. If left untreated, an aneurysm can
rupture and result in sudden, severe bleeding - just as a balloon will burst when inflated beyond
its capacity.

Survival after aortic aneurysm rupture is less than 20%. Endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR) is the
current standard of care for treating AAAs. It involves inserting a stent graft into the site of the
aneurysm through a small incision in the groin. It is positioned and expanded to support the
weakened artery walls and reduce the risk of rupture.

### Globally, there are over 250,000 EVAR procedures performed each year, representing a $3.2B
### market.

## The Challenge

Despite the success of EVAR in reducing mortality rates and improving patient outcomes, endoleaks
remain a major issue, impacting up to 50% of patients. Endoleak is a common and serious complication
that occurs when blood leaks back into the aneurysm sac, which can cause the aneurysm to continue to
grow and potentially rupture. In fact, up to 20% of patients who undergo EVAR require a repeat
procedure within 5 years due to endoleaks. This high rate of reintervention can result in
significant healthcare spending, with over $1.5B added to the U.S. healthcare system each year.
Given the high incidence of endoleaks and their associated risks, there is a critical need to find
effective solutions to mitigate this complication and improve patient outcomes following EVAR.

## The Solution

Our minimally-invasive, catheter-based technology places a self-deploying stent between the
high-pressure aneurysm sac and low-pressure nearby vein, allowing for the continuous drainage of
endoleaks and depressurization of the aneurysmal sac following EVAR. Representing a significant
improvement over the current standard of care for abdominal aortic aneurysm treatment, our
technology aims to improve procedure outcomes and allow patients to live longer, healthier lives
after abdominal aortic aneurysm repair.
