# **1 Sperm + 1 Egg= 1 New Miraculous  Life **                                                    
                                                                                                  
# **Conception and the Spark of a New Life and Soul**                                             
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

The most miraculous event in all of human biology, within the grasp of all human experience, is
conception.

Two cells meet and bond at the right place at the right time and a new life is created.  Most the
time things go well, but sometimes they do not.

This event gives us insight into all other happenings in life. Two parts connect and bond at the
right place and the right time, creating a new whole ….  and here starts our story.

### And in the living world similar events are taking place in and all around us

### The thinking of the Common Vein is best described by

### Archilogus
### and his quote about
### The Fox and the Hedgehog

 


Isaiah Berlin expanded the sentence into an essay expressing the concept of the differences between
centripetal and centrifugal thought and approach to the events in the world

### The Pursuit of Oneness is both
### Conscious and Unconscious


If things are good then there is order and health, and if things are bad there is disorder and
disease.

#### Thumbs Up, Thumbs Down or Somewhere in Between



It is our purpose in life to find the disorder and try and bring it back to order.  It is called
Tikun Olam in Jewish culture – or  “healing the world”.

This is not only the beginning but also the end of the story of The Common Vein..

#### [BIOGRAPHY][163]

This web site reflects the  philosophical, educational, and artistic pursuits of Ashley Davidoff MD,
a resident of Newton Massachusetts.

The essence of the work revolves around the concept that the whole is bigger than its component
parts.

The program encompasses a multidisciplinary approach  including biology, medicine, art, photography,
music, poetry and gardening  to exemplify the unifying principles that govern the complexity of life
in and around us.

The Common Vein is a web based educational project that explores complex issues by identifying the
underlying principles and recurring patterns of the world around and in us.

**For Whom?**

TCV makes the principles of life and biology accessible to anybody. It is designed with the belief
that the complexities of life and biology in order (health ) and disorder (disease), have roots in
simple principles. TCV lays down these foundation tenets in the opening pages, and then advances in
step-wise fashion to complexity.

#### Why?

To promote not only learning, but also [understanding][178] and appreciation.

#### How?

Fewer words more images.

The Common Vein is a web based educational project that explores complex issues by identifying the
underlying principles and recurring patterns of the world around and in us.

**For Whom?**

TCV makes the principles of life and biology accessible to anybody. It is designed with the belief
that the complexities of life and biology in order (health ) and disorder (disease), have roots in
simple principles. TCV lays down these foundation tenets in the opening pages, and then advances in
step-wise fashion to complexity.

#### Why?

To promote not only learning, but also [understanding][178] and appreciation.

#### How?

Fewer words more images.

**Patient Notification**

UT Southwestern Medical Center is notifying affected patients of a privacy incident involving
patient information in accordance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act
(HIPAA), as some individuals could not be reached by mail.

On Jan. 14, 2026, UT Southwestern became aware of a privacy incident involving the Care Everywhere
health information exchange (HIE). In December 2025, vendors SelfRx, Ravilla, GuardDog, and Mammoth
accessed patient information beyond their authorized scope without a valid treatment, payment, or

address, date of birth, medication information, and treatment history. It did not include credit

information was further disclosed, misused, or retained.

UTSW took immediate steps to terminate unauthorized access, secure affected systems, identify and
notify impacted individuals, and implement additional safeguards, including enhanced access
controls, monitoring, and oversight of HIE activity. No action is required at this time. As a
precaution, we encourage you to review healthcare statements and communications and report any
concerns. Impacted individuals can contact our dedicated call center at [833-445-1229][89]. We
deeply regret the occurrence of this incident and any worry, distress, or difficulty that it may
cause. We appreciate the trust you place in UT Southwestern for your healthcare.

## Specialty Highlights

We bring world-class care to you, delivered with expertise and compassion. Learn more about our
leading-edge therapies, innovative treatments, and exceptional specialty care.

## UTSWMyCare App

UT Southwestern’s patient care app – UTSWMyCare – helps you easily manage your health and stay
connected to UTSW and your provider. Find a physician. Access your medical records. Schedule
appointments, and much more.

UTSWMyCare is simple to use, convenient, and always available. It’s medicine made easier.

[Learn More][96]

[Clements University Hospital image]

Our Hospital & Clinics

With our University Hospital, over 40 locations, and several hundred clinics, at UT Southwestern you
can find experienced doctors and specialists to provide the care that you need close to home.

[Find a Location][97]

## Virtual Visits with your Doctor

A Video Visit is a safe and convenient way to get access to a broad spectrum of primary and
specialty services at UT Southwestern while still receiving the same high-quality care you would
receive in person—saving you time and travel.

[Get Started with Your Virtual Visit][98]

## Breakthrough science. Exceptional care.

UT Southwestern Medical Center is the No. 1 hospital in Dallas-Fort Worth for the ninth consecutive
year and ranks among the nation's top hospitals for care in 12 specialties – the most in Texas,
according to [U.S. News & World Report][68]. Combining breakthrough science with the latest medical
advancements, UT Southwestern sets the standard for innovative, compassionate, high-quality patient
care for North Texas.

## The Spark of Innovation

Our mission of discovery and healing comes alive every day in the research labs, classrooms, and
clinical spaces all across our campus in Dallas-Fort Worth. That’s where some of the brightest minds
in science and medicine are following their spark and connecting the dots between bold ideas and
tangible, lifesaving treatments for our patients.

[Learn More][88]

**Patient Notification**

UT Southwestern Medical Center is notifying affected patients of a privacy incident involving
patient information in accordance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act
(HIPAA), as some individuals could not be reached by mail.

On Jan. 14, 2026, UT Southwestern became aware of a privacy incident involving the Care Everywhere
health information exchange (HIE). In December 2025, vendors SelfRx, Ravilla, GuardDog, and Mammoth
accessed patient information beyond their authorized scope without a valid treatment, payment, or
healthcare operations purpose. The information varied by individual and may have included name,
address, date of birth, medication information, and treatment history. It did not include credit
card numbers or other financial account information. At this time, there is no evidence the
information was further disclosed, misused, or retained.

UTSW took immediate steps to terminate unauthorized access, secure affected systems, identify and
notify impacted individuals, and implement additional safeguards, including enhanced access
controls, monitoring, and oversight of HIE activity. No action is required at this time. As a
precaution, we encourage you to review healthcare statements and communications and report any
concerns. Impacted individuals can contact our dedicated call center at [833-445-1229][89]. We
deeply regret the occurrence of this incident and any worry, distress, or difficulty that it may
cause. We appreciate the trust you place in UT Southwestern for your healthcare.

## Specialty Highlights

We bring world-class care to you, delivered with expertise and compassion. Learn more about our
leading-edge therapies, innovative treatments, and exceptional specialty care.
* [ [Clements University Hospital] Clements University Hospital ][90]
* [ [Comprehensive Heart and Vascular Center] Comprehensive Heart and Vascular Center ][91]

* [ [Simmons Comprehensive Cancer Center] Simmons Comprehensive Cancer Center ][93]
* [ [Spine Center] Spine Center ][94]
* [ [Transplant] Transplant ][95]

## UTSWMyCare App

UT Southwestern’s patient care app – UTSWMyCare – helps you easily manage your health and stay
connected to UTSW and your provider. Find a physician. Access your medical records. Schedule
appointments, and much more.

UTSWMyCare is simple to use, convenient, and always available. It’s medicine made easier.

[Learn More][96]

[Clements University Hospital image]

Our Hospital & Clinics

With our University Hospital, over 40 locations, and several hundred clinics, at UT Southwestern you
can find experienced doctors and specialists to provide the care that you need close to home.

[Find a Location][97]

## Virtual Visits with your Doctor

A Video Visit is a safe and convenient way to get access to a broad spectrum of primary and
specialty services at UT Southwestern while still receiving the same high-quality care you would
receive in person—saving you time and travel.

[Get Started with Your Virtual Visit][98]
